misp-threat-actor.description: GhostSec is a hacktivist group that emerged as an offshoot of Anonymous. They primarily focused on counterterrorism efforts and monitoring online activities associated with terrorism. They gained prominence following the 2015 Charlie Hebdo shooting in Paris and the rise of ISIS.

misp-tidal-groups.description:
GhostSec is a sophisticated hacktivist group that was initially formed in 2015 as an offshoot of the Anonymous hacktivist group to disrupt ISIS-related online propaganda and recently formed a hacking collective entity known as "The Five Families" that includes ThreatSec, Stormous, Blackforums, SiegedSec, GhostSec.

It has compromised multiple sectors including critical infrastructure, telecommunications, energy, defense in over 18 countries for achieving its ideological objectives. It uses a wide range of techniques for launching DDoS attack, exfiltrating lucrative data and defacement.<sup>[[Cisco Talos Blog March 5 2024](/references/bcdd2d44-a47a-4749-b61b-025086011f17)]</sup><sup>[[Wikimedia Foundation Inc. limitations: Exact normalized-name matching does not prove one-to-one actor identity.
MISP Galaxy is an aggregation layer; original references remain authoritative.
A no-match result means no exact match in the fixed datasets, not that the actor does not exist.
A Malpedia name match confirms catalogue presence only, not actor use.
